intro.title: Company introduction
intro.body: Batam Stream Lab has delivered hybrid event, streaming, and multimedia solutions since 2020. We combine creative direction with broadcast engineering to help organizations connect audiences across physical and digital stages. From Batam, we support productions across Indonesia and Singapore with reliable crews and field-tested workflows.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers before we go live together.

items.q: What services does Batam Stream Lab provide?
items.a: We deliver live streaming, hybrid event systems, LED visual environments, multi-camera production, virtual events, and full audio visual support with trained operators.

items.q: Do you support events outside Batam?
items.a: Yes. While we are headquartered in Batam, we mobilize crews and fly-packs across Indonesia and Singapore depending on production scope and schedule.
Absolutely. We routinely support corporate keynotes, town halls, expos, and executive broadcasts with redundant streaming, comms infrastructure, and brand-safe graphics.
We integrate with major RTMP/SRT destinations including YouTube, Vimeo, custom CDNs, private players, and webinar platforms—tailored to your security and analytics needs.

items.q: Do you provide internet backup systems?
items.a: Yes. We can deploy bonded cellular, dual-path fiber, and failover routing to keep critical streams resilient when venue networks fluctuate.
On-site technical surveys are available to map power, rigging, sightlines, network paths, and LED loading—ideal for first-time venues or complex hybrid setups.
